adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. Given the variable name and subsequent permission check (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) FORBIDDEN`), this will incorrectly forbid team admins who are not owners from using `addGuests`.
